# Smoky Mountain Espresso

> Independent, family-owned coffee shop at 1259 Middle Creek Rd, Sevierville, TN 37862, open since 2018. Award-winning espresso drinks made with Crimson Cup coffee, a self-serve sweetFrog frozen yogurt bar inside the shop, and fresh pastries from Crust & Crumb Bakery (Gatlinburg). About ten minutes from Dollywood and the Pigeon Forge Parkway. Phone: (865) 366-1685. Open Mon–Thu 7:30 AM–9:00 PM, Fri–Sat 7:30 AM–9:30 PM, Sun 1:00–9:00 PM.

Known for: the Smoky Mountain Mocha Freeze (white chocolate + caramel + espresso, blended), red velvet lattes, nitro cold brew, coffee flights, and a cozy fireplace room. 4.6-star Google rating with 800+ five-star reviews; 98% recommend on Facebook.
